CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 13

2. Solve for x: x + 7 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 18
   D. 11

3. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 82

4. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

5. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

6. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 2

7. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 1
   D. 7

9. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

11. Solve for x: x + 3 = 7. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 3
   C. 5
   D. 4

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

13. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 23
   C. 7
   D. 19

14. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121

   D. 22

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32

   C. 33
   D. 12

17. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50

18. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)

20. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)

24. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
